verses.t: “Kismiṁ loko samuppanno, kismiṁ kubbati santhavaṁ; Kissa loko upādāya, kismiṁ loko vihaññatī”ti.
“Chasu loko samuppanno, chasu kubbati santhavaṁ; Channameva upādāya, chasu loko vihaññatī”ti. Addhavaggo sattamo.
Nāmaṁ cittañca taṇhā ca, saṁyojanañca bandhanā; Abbhāhatuḍḍito pihito, icchā lokena te dasāti.
